description: Ministry of Development Strategies & International Trade - Rescinded that the Scheme for Registration of Exporters Regulations
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by a minister under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, specifically rescinding previous regulations. It deals with legal/regulatory matters (new regulations and rescission of existing ones) rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or any other specialized category. The mention of a minister's name is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
